# Xenosys Solutions

> Web design and development company in Doha, Qatar. We design, host and maintain websites and business software for small businesses and startups in Qatar.

- Office: Icono View Offices, Doha, Qatar
- WhatsApp / phone: +974 7064 3918
- Email: info@xenosysweb.com
- Languages on the website: English, Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, Malayalam, Bengali, Nepali

## Services

- Website design and development (mobile-friendly)
- Hosting and domain setup
- Website fixes and updates
- Google search setup
- Custom ERP with POS (billing and stock)
- Digital marketing

## Startup Support Package

QR 99 for a complete website for 1 year: free subdomain, free hosting for 1 year, and professional website design and development. Renewal after the first year is agreed separately with each client. An independent offer from Xenosys Solutions, not a government programme.
